items.title: How much linking effort does a note actually need to be findable later?
items.description: Priya's habit is a short, roughly 3-minute processing-and-linking pass per note — not a heavy filing ritual. Assume every minute spent processing and linking a note adds to the odds it gets found and reused when it's actually needed later, with fast early gains that taper off. Drag the slider to see how much of that improvement comes from the first few minutes versus the rest.

params.name: linkingMinutes
params.label: Minutes spent processing and linking a note

items.compute: const ceiling = 95; const rate = 0.5; const resurfaceOdds = params.linkingMinutes === 0 ? 0 : ceiling * (1 - Math.exp(-rate * params.linkingMinutes)); return { resurfaceOdds: Math.round(resurfaceOdds * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Odds the note gets found and reused later
